section.sectionSummaryBrief: The body's natural delight in physical things stems from their inner connection to it, and through wealth and delicacies, the knowledge of Hashem fills the earth, akin to the soul being nourished by the body.
section.t: And one can explain the elucidation of this,
that the fact that the body naturally delights in physical things
[delicacies,
and likewise great wealth]
is because these matters pertain to the body from the aspect of its inner essence
[and its connection to these things is not only from the aspect of its materiality, but also
(primarily)
from the aspect of its inner essence],
and therefore,
through great wealth and delicacies, there will be an increase in the filling of the earth with knowledge of Hashem—in the manner of the concept that the soul will be nourished from the body.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The root of the body is higher than the root of the soul, analogous to vessels being higher than lights, and this is because the purpose of lights and vessels is for Israel, so that through them the dynamic of soul and body may be drawn down, with the body containing the choice of Atzmus.
section.t: And 4)
Now, it is explained in many places68
that the root of the body is higher than the root of the soul,
this is
because soul and body are analogous to lights and vessels, and the root of the vessels is higher than the root of the lights.
And just as through the drawing down and enclothing of the lights within the vessels, an advantage and addition is made in the lights,
so too is it with soul and body,
that through the descent of the soul and its enclothing in the body, the soul is elevated to a higher level than it was before its descent.
And based on the known principle69
that creation is for the sake of Israel,51
the intention of this is not only for the creation of the world, but for all revelations,
one can say,
that the inner reason for the fact that the root of the vessels is higher than the root of the lights
[and that through the vessels an advantage is made in the lights]
is because the purpose of lights and vessels is for the sake of Israel,
in order that through them the concept of soul and body may be drawn,
and since the root of the body is higher than the root of the soul,
for in the body is the choice of Atzmus,
therefore lights and vessels were brought into being in a manner that the root of the vessels is higher than the root of the lights.
[However, with soul and body,
that the root of the body is higher than the root of the soul is that in the body is the choice of Atzmus
(free choice,
and this is not related to the essence and virtue of the body),
and with lights and vessels,
that the root of the vessels is higher than the root of the lights pertains to their essence as vessels.
And through this, it is likewise made in soul and body that descended from them,
that the root of the body being higher than the root of the soul also pertains to the essence and virtue of the body].

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The advantage gained through the refinement of the nations, whose source is in the vessels, will also exist in the future, just as the soul's elevation through the body results in the soul being nourished by the body in the future.
section.t: And based on this, one can explain the reason for the fact that the advantage through the refinement of the nations
[who receive from the angels, whose root is from the vessels]
will also be in the days of Mashiach
(as above, section 6),
because that through the vessels an advantage is made in the lights is because the
(true)
root of lights and vessels is the concept of soul and body,
and therefore,

just as the elevation of the soul through the body is not only that through the soul's service in the body it is afterwards elevated to a higher level, but also that the elevation itself in the future is that the soul is nourished from the body,
so too is it regarding the advantage through the vessels,
and likewise the advantage through the angels whose root is from the vessels,
and likewise the advantage through the refinement of the nations of the world who receive from the angels,
that this advantage will also be in the future,
for through "You will judge the peoples with equity," there will be an addition in the influence drawn down to Israel.
